method: 120 purposeful critical-language candidates (including nonliteral/contextual cases) + 80 stratified random public-group comments
seed_use: seeded random allocation/sample for the 80-item cohort; priority choices are nonrandom; a separate seed shuffles human rows

random_protocol.quota_allocation: equal movie allocation with remainder by seeded movie order; within each movie, equal post allocation with remainder by seeded post order

movie_id_semantics: Topic supplied to the source-post crawler; a comment may compare other films. It is not a verified exclusive sentiment target.
future_use: Train/development candidates after human review. Do not use this purposively selected or assistant-exposed pool as representative independent test. Reserve selected source posts and duplicate-connected groups; film holdouts must also account for other films mentioned in the same comments.
